metadata.purpose: Track candidate real-world datasets before they are imported into scenarios, parameters, or calibration targets.
metadata.notes: Keep raw files and licenses separate. This registry records what each source is allowed to influence.

sources.name: Mitte rent reference candidate

provenance.access_notes: Fill before import. Prefer official or legally reusable sources.

unit_policy.canonical_unit: EUR per square meter per month
unit_policy.conversion_notes: Convert warm/cold rent consistently before writing median_rent_per_sqm.

geography.mapping_notes: Record whether values are district-wide, postal-code-level, block-level, or listing-level.

quality_checks: Confirm rent definition and whether utilities are included.
Check sample period and remove stale listing snapshots.
Compare median and percentile spread before replacing synthetic values.
sources.import_notes: Use first as calibration target, then scenario initialization if geography is detailed enough.

sources.name: Mitte purchase price candidate

provenance.access_notes: Fill before import. Prefer transaction summaries or official market reports where available.

unit_policy.conversion_notes: Keep apartment, building, and land values separated if source permits.

geography.mapping_notes: Do not mix district-level purchase prices with block-level rent values without recording aggregation.

quality_checks: Check whether values are asking prices, appraisals, or transactions.
Separate residential apartments from commercial or land-only records.
Record outlier policy before calculating medians.
sources.import_notes: Use for sale-price calibration and purchase affordability indicators.

sources.name: Household income and affordability candidate

provenance.access_notes: Fill before import. Prefer sources with household size or person-level distribution.

unit_policy.conversion_notes: Record whether gross or net income is used and whether household size adjustment is applied.

geography.mapping_notes: If only district-level values are available, mark uncertainty before assigning to households.

quality_checks: Avoid using mean income alone if distribution data is available.
sources.import_notes: Use to calibrate household income distributions and rent-burden targets.

sources.name: Spatial influence candidate

provenance.access_notes: Fill before import. Can combine distance, transit, workplace density, tourism, and public anchors.

unit_policy.conversion_notes: Normalize each input layer before combining into directed influence weights.

geography.mapping_notes: Record whether influence is symmetric or directed.

quality_checks: Keep positive pressure and stabilizing influence separate.
Run sensitivity tests before treating weights as calibrated.
sources.import_notes: Use to replace hand-written influence arrows after sensitivity tests.
